desk.headline: Q3 profit up 11% to ₩1.58tn (reported 27 Oct), in line with estimates; no guidance

other.label: Net income attributable to controlling interest, Q3
Net income attributable to controlling interest, 9 months

results: Shinhan's Q3 results came out on 27 October; the 13 November filing only updates its largest shareholder's stake.
Preliminary Q3 profit rose 11% to ₩1.58tn but fell 13% from Q2's ₩1.82tn; nine-month profit rose 13% to ₩5.03tn.
Profit was roughly in line with the ₩1.61tn analysts expected, according to Yonhap.
Operating income dipped 2.4% to ₩1.91tn; Shinhan Bank's profit rose 12.5% to ₩1.23tn.
The National Pension Service trimmed its holding to 43.2m shares (9.20%) from 43.5m (9.26%).

guidance.summary: Shinhan gives no earnings guidance in these filings.

watch: Whether profit picks up again after the drop from Q2.
Audited Q3 figures, as the reported numbers are preliminary.
Further changes in the National Pension Service's holding.
